'khor ba'i snying bo/kha par las khyod dang kha brda thengs mang byas kyang /ngas da dung ci zhig bshad ma tshar ba dang 'dra la/'phrin yig cig bris te sems gtam yongs rdzogs shar mar zhu bsams kyang /skad cha mang drags pas gang nas mgo rtsom dgos pa yang mi shes/de bas/ da lta/gang du song yang ngas ci zhig bor zin pa dang 'dra la/gang nas bsdad kyang ngas ci zhig brjed song ba dang mtshungs/nying 'jags kyi mtshan mor/mi skad dang 'phrul chas kyi 'ur sgra ci yang med pa'i mtshan gung /glog sgron gzims shing mig zung btsums/3
ñcalag pa snying gar bzhag nas ga ler bsams na/khyod kyi zhal ngo thengs gcig la dngos su rig thub tshe/nga la bshad dgos pa'i skad cha gzhan ci yang med cing /khyod kyi 'gram par sems chung ngang 'o zhig byed thub na/nga la brjed song ba'i don dag gzhan ci yang med par tshor/red ya/ 'jig rten 'di na/nga la khyod las gzhan ci zhig yod/'khor 'das yod tshad stong bar song zhing /chos thams cad bdag dang bdag gi pa med par gyur kyang /nga'i 'jig rten du khyod kho na stong du mi rung zhing /khyod gcig pu da gzod nga la dbang nges par 'dod/cham nad thengs shig gi rjes su/ngas zag bcas kyi phung bo 'di sdug bsngal gsum las thar ba'i re ba med cing /pha ma bu phrug dang gnyen nye grogs tshong 'dus kyi mgron po bzhin nam 'thor la'ang nges pa med la/thob mnga' thang dang mtshan snyan grags kyang brag ca'i stong skad dang mtshungs par rtogs/tha na rang lus kyang gshin rjes g.yar ma yin par nges shes gting nas skyes kyang /4
ngas sngar bzhin khyod kho na nga la dbang bar u tshugs byed 'dod/min nam/ dam nga/'i gsung rab kyi me lces gtan nas bzhu ma thub cing /rtog ge'i gtan tshigs kyi skyogs rdos nam yang gtor ma phod la/'jig rten khrims srol gyi gser srab kyis kyang 'jun ma nus pa zhignga'i rdo rje'i snying kha na rtag tu brtan brling nger yod pa ni/nga'i tshe srog gi 'bab rgyun la sim pa'i khyod min na su yin/gces pa'i ngag 'khreng ba'i sems/ 'jam pa'i lus/da dung mdzes pa'i spyod pa dang byams pa'i mig gi lta stangs re re yang /nga'i snying gi thig le la 'dzer ma bzhin 'thas zin pas/ngas 'di dag thams cad snying bo med par ji ltar bsgom thub/kye/ 'khor ba la snying bo yod kikhyod yod pas/ 'khor ba la snying bo yod kri yong /'khor ba la snying bo yod pas/ngas 'tsho ba 'tsho bar shes shing dkon mchog dkon mchog tu rtogs/5
'khor ba la snying bo yod pas/ngas pha ma pha mar shes shing bla ma bla mar rtogs/'khor ba la snying bo yod pas/ngas da gzod mdzes pa mdzes par shes shing bden pa bden par rtogs/ngo ma/ gnam 'og 'di na/'khor ba la snying bo med ces bshad thub mkhan du yod/bdag cag gi ston pas kyang 'khor ba stobs dang ldan zhes gsungs myong /go'am/ 'khor ba'i rten phur lags/'jig rten 'khor ba 'di skyo gdung gi gtam rgyud cig min la/mi yul 'tsho ba 'di don med kyi skyo glu zhig kyang min/gnas 'di nas/byas legs na lag pa 'gul stangs tsam gyis kyang /zag med thar ba'i rgyal thabs khrigs ser 'dzin thub cing /stabs nyes na rkang ba spo tshul tsam gyis kyang /na rag dmyal khams bco brgyad lhan du 'grims srid pa'i bden pa yod 'dug pas/da nas bzung /ngas rang nyid kyi nyi ma re re dang skar cha re re'i go 6
skabs kyang 'chor du mi 'jug la/ngas rang nyid kyi gom 'gros re re dang skad cha re re yang chud zos su gtong mi srid par/dus nam zhig na 'u cag thun mong gi las smon dkar po de/tshe gcig lus gcig la/mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mngon du byed par sta gon byed nges pas/da lta 'u gnyis le dbar stong gis bar thag bskal na yang /khyod kyis nga'i yod tshad la sems khral gnang mi dgos/rgyu mtshan ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya yongs la/thob dka' don che mi lus gces par skyongs zhes yang yang gsungs yod pas/ngas kyang khyod nyid nga'i gam na dngos su yod pa bzhin/rang lus la sngar las lhag pa'i bdag skyong byed srid na/khyod kyis nga'i ci la yang sems khral gnang mi dgos/go'am/ 'khor ba'i bla srog ang /7
'khor ba'i mgron po/sha khrag gi phung bo zhig g.yar nas/'jig rten la lan gcig 'ong thub kyang /snang ba'i kha sgo btsan po nas/rang gshis la bcos bsgyur ma thebs pa dkon po 'duglo rgyus la bltas na/mkhas mdzangs kyi rgyal blon/'gro 'dren gyi bla mchod/dus gsum gyi bdag po thams cad kyang /sa gnas shig gam mi rigs shig gi khor yug las brgal mi 'dug la/lung ba chung chung zhig gi bde sdug las thar thub med/gnas lugs 'di rtogs pas mi rnams ha las shing /8
mis rang gi 'tsho gnas kyi dka' khag dang /rang gi rmongs skyo'ang da gzod glo bur tshor ba 'dra/mos pa'i 'dun ma ri chu'am sa rdo tsam la bcol nas/sems 'gul gyi mig chu shar shar gtong ba tsho snying re rje/mi sna zhig gam dgongs don zhig ngo sor 'khyer nas/'go nad rang lus su len mkhan dag kyang da dung sad med pa 'dra/rang gi rdog sne na lam bu grangs med yod la/lam bu re re'ang 'khor ba'i dkyil snying du zug yod pas/sdod cig gang / tsog pur sdod la/snod bcud kyi chos nyid nyams su longs dang /nga tshos blo las 'gongs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi lta sgrung bskrun thub nges/ngo ma yin/mi tshe ni rmi lam thung ngu zhig gi yun dang /nga tsho ni 'khor ba 'di'i zhag gcig gi mgron po dang 'dra yang /nga tsho'i da lta'i 'dug stangs tsam mam/'dzum dmul dmul gyi bzo lta tsam gyis kyang /lo rgyus kyi kha phyogs brje thub la/yangs pa'i 'jig rten mi yul 'dir/yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtam rgyud grangs med 'jog thub/9
'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/'jig rten chung chung 'di ru/ gom pa ji ltar spos kyang /lam thag ring bo zhig gam/ sa rgya chen po zhig gcod ma thub la/rkang ba gang la bzhag kyang /nyams bde ba'i snang ba ci yang ma byung bas/nga / 'khrul ba med pa'i pha yul du log 'dod/lam kha na/ rgyus yod rgyus med kyi mi tshogs rlabs bzhin 'phyo/ngo gdong mang bo/ nga kho nar 'khor med la/mig 'od tshang ma/ nga kho nar phyogs med pas/nga la thang chad cing yid pham pa'i shugs ring nar nar shor/yun ring gi rjes su/ngal gso zhig dang bcas phyir lta byed dus/ a tsi/10
ma gzhi rang nyid rang gi sgo them yang brgal med pa tshor/red ya/ nga tshos rang nyid ji ltar bcos kyang /nga tsho nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i mgron po yin la/nga tshos sdod khang gi gzhi ma dang ang grangs ji ltar brjes kyang /nga tsho nam yang 'gro la nye ba'i mgron po ste/rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang gis/nga tshos nam yang pham kha khur nas ma song sa gang yod/bden bden lta bu'i 'jig rten pa'i mnar gcod dang /skyo skyo 'dra ba'i 'khor ba pa'i sdug bsngal kho nas kyang /nga tshor sos dal gyi go skabs byin nas/snang glu skyid po zhig kyang len du ma bcug pas/pham kha ngas ma khur na su yis khur/da dung shing gi seng ge shog bu'i stag mo/la ca'i ne tso/ gzhan yang /nyen khas lngid tig ger 'tsho ba'i 'khor ba'i gru zur kun na/ches mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang ngag rgyun grangs med la/ches mtshar ba'i ltad mo dang ku re mang bos/zur mig shig shig dang 'phya dgod lhang lhang gis nga tshor sgug yod pas/da lta nga pha yul du log 'dod/11
